exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System (RTGCS) groups
cohort: The study included 500 patients aged 18-35 years who delivered by caesarean section after 28 weeks of gestation at Karachi Metropolitan University / Abbasi Shaheed Hospital Karachi.
finding: Robson Group V was the leading contributor (60%) to the caesarean section rate, followed by Robson Group II.
mod_finding: Robson Group V (women with a previous caesarean section and a singleton term cephalic-presentation pregnancy) was the leading contributor to the caesarean section rate, followed by Group II (nulliparous women with induced labour or previous caesarean section before labour).
